name: Mr. Pizza Restaurant & Tavern
tagline: Delicious Pizza, Burgers and Family Style Lunch & Dinner.
seo_title: Mr. Pizza Restaurant & Tavern | Pizza, Burgers & Family Style Dining in Gorham, NH
seo_desc: Pizza, burgers, seafood and comfort food at 160 Main Street, Gorham, NH, with Hobbit's Tavern. Full menu with prices. Call (603) 915-9266.

menu.note: 10" and 16". Build your own on a cheese pie, or pick a house specialty.

items.name: Queen Margherita
items.desc: Base of house tomato sauce. Topped with roasted cherry tomatoes, fresh mozzarella cheese, basil leaves finished with parmesan cheese.

items.name: Mighty Meaty
items.desc: Base of house tomato sauce. Topped with hot Italian sausage, ground certified Angus beef, Texas thick bacon, capicola ham, pepperoni with our blend of shredded mozzarella and provolone cheese.

items.name: Veg Out
items.desc: Base of house tomato sauce. Topped with spinach, bell peppers, mushrooms, roasted cherry tomatoes, roasted garlic, artichoke hearts and our blend of shredded mozzarella and provolone cheese.

items.name: Spicy BBQ Chicken
items.desc: Base of BBQ sauce. Topped with grilled diced chicken, red onion, jalapeño and our blend of shredded mozzarella and provolone cheese.

items.name: Pesto Chicken
items.desc: Base of house tomato sauce. Topped with spinach, roasted cherry tomatoes, feta and our blend of shredded mozzarella and provolone cheese finished with pesto drizzle.

items.name: Chicken Bacon Ranch
items.desc: Base of house tomato sauce. Topped with grilled chicken, bacon and a ranch drizzle.

items.name: Buffalo Chicken
items.desc: Base of honey buffalo sauce. Topped with our cheese blend, loads of chicken and a ranch drizzle.

items.name: Loaded
items.desc: Base of house tomato sauce. Topped with bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, pepperoni, hamburg.

items.name: Pretzel Bites
items.desc: Each nugget is freshly baked to a golden brown. Our nuggets may look mini, but they sure are mighty. Served with a honey mustard and a beer cheese sauce.

items.name: Chicken Wings
items.desc: 8 jumbo chicken wings tossed in your choice of sauce. Sauces: Sweet Chili, House Honey Buffalo, Jerk, XXXtreme, Teriyaki.

items.name: Chicken Tenders
items.desc: Freshly battered in-house, your choice of sauce. Sauces: Sweet Chili, House Honey Buffalo, Jerk, XXXtreme, Teriyaki.

items.name: Poutine
items.desc: Canadian style poutine featuring our house fries topped with beef gravy and cheese curds.

items.name: Crab Cakes
items.desc: Maryland style crab cakes feature authentically seasoned breading and stuffing with generous portions of moist, sweet crabmeat, served with smoky chipotle aioli.

items.name: Bacon Wrapped Scallops
items.desc: Scallops are delicious on their own, but when you cover them in bacon you end up with decadent little bites served with local maple syrup.

items.name: Crab Rangoon Dip
items.desc: Hot, creamy, cheesy and loaded with crab, this dip is perfect! Served with fried wonton chips.

items.name: Mini Baked Brie
items.desc: Cheeses topped with candied walnuts and our housemade cranberry coulis served with crostinis.

items.name: Loaded Potato Wedges
items.desc: Baked until crispy and topped with cheddar, bacon, chives topped with a drizzle of sriracha sour cream sauce.

menu.note: Add protein: blackened salmon $12, grilled chicken $7, crab cakes $15, veggie patty $8.

items.name: Antipasto
items.desc: An Italian salad that everyone loves! Mixed greens topped with Genoa salami, mortadella, capicola, provolone, roasted cherry tomatoes, artichoke hearts, bell peppers and olives.

items.name: Beet & Goat Cheese
items.desc: Roasted beets over mixed greens topped with creamy goat cheese, pickled red onion and candied walnuts.

items.name: Classic Garden
items.desc: Fresh crispy veggies served over mixed greens.

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.desc: Crisp, chilled romaine lettuce tossed with croutons, parmesan cheese, and zesty Caesar dressing, topped with more parmesan cheese.

items.name: Wedge Salad
items.desc: Crisp iceberg wedge topped with bacon crumbles, pickled red onion, tomatoes and a creamy blue cheese dressing and a balsamic drizzle.

menu.note: All sandwiches come with house made chips. Upgrade your side for $4: fries, tater tots, sweet fries, onion rings, cole slaw or a side salad.

items.name: Steak and Cheese
items.desc: Tender shredded sirloin and creamy American cheese, cooked up and loaded onto a baguette. Add peppers, onions and mushrooms for $3.

items.name: Pastrami
items.desc: Black pastrami grilled up with Swiss cheese, loaded onto a baguette.

items.name: Meatball
items.desc: Loaded with our house-made meatballs and sauce, topped with provolone, served on a toasted baguette.

items.name: Fried Haddock Filet
items.desc: Fresh filet of haddock, lightly breaded and fried in house, served on a bun with tartar sauce.

items.name: Chicken Breast
items.desc: A 6 oz. chicken breast, grilled or fried to perfection, served on a bun. Make it black and blue, +$2.

items.name: Chicken Parm Sub
items.desc: Tender, juicy, crispy chicken topped with marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese, baked, served hot and saucy.

items.name: Smash Burger
items.desc: Seared certified Angus beef patty, served on a bun.

items.name: Twin Hot Dogs
items.desc: With choice of side.

items.name: Original Spicy Italian
items.desc: Salami, pepperoni, spicy capicola and provolone cheese topped with lettuce, tomatoes, bell peppers, black olives and hot pepper relish, olive oil and red wine vinegar.

items.name: B.L.T.
items.desc: Loads of thick sliced bacon, finely shredded lettuce and thinly sliced tomato with mayo, served on a baguette.

items.name: T.B.L.T.
items.desc: Just like our B.L.T. with the addition of sliced turkey breast, served on a baguette.

items.name: Lobster Roll
items.desc: A buttery toasted lobster roll with plump juicy lobster salad piled high. Maine lobster meat lightly tossed in mayo.

menu.note: Steak and seafood entrees are served with coleslaw or vegetable of the day and a choice of french fries, sweet fries, onion rings, baked potato, mashed potato or tater tots.

items.name: Fried Shrimp
items.desc: Shrimp, shrimp, glorious, fried shrimp.

items.name: Fried Haddock
items.desc: Fresh fish is always, always better, especially when you are deep-frying it in batter.

items.name: Fried Scallops
items.desc: Fried sea scallops are a real treat. Most everything tastes better fried, including scallops.

items.name: Seafood Casserole
items.desc: New England classic consisting of haddock, shrimp and plump scallops topped with our crab meat stuffing and our lobster sauce.

items.name: Baked Stuffed Haddock
items.desc: A baked fish that has been stuffed with crabmeat, of course!

items.name: Seared Scallops
items.desc: Pan-seared scallops make an elegant dinner! To finish the dish, a simple lemon-butter pan sauce.

items.name: Pan-Seared Salmon
items.desc: Try it blackened! A nice hint of a charred flavor in every tender bite.

items.name: Butcher's Cut
items.desc: Chargrilled to your desired temperature, richly flavored and deliciously juicy.

items.name: Macaroni and Cheese
items.desc: A heaping bowl of pasta covered in our creamy cheese sauce. Feeling fancy? Add buffalo chicken $8. Add lobster $15.

items.name: American Chop Suey
items.desc: It's a New England thing, it's pure comfort food. Served with a buttery baguette slice bursting with flavor from fresh garlic and parsley.

items.name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
items.desc: A classic, family favorite meal! Tender, juicy meatballs over a bed of spaghetti with hearty marinara sauce and garlic baguette.

items.name: Chicken Parmesan
items.desc: Breaded chicken that is fried and then baked with rich tomato sauce, Italian cheese, and herbs. Served over a bed of pasta and garlic bread.

items.name: Meatloaf
items.desc: Tender and juicy on the inside with a sweet and tangy glaze. Served with gravy over mashed potatoes and vegetable of the day.

items.name: Pot Roast
items.desc: Fall-apart-tender pot roast served with gravy over mashed potatoes and vegetable of the day.
